verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a dedicated sandbox: a separate signup at sandbox.mercury.com, separate API and OAuth2 base URLs, and pre-loaded dummy organizations, accounts, transactions and balances with no real money involved. Production tokens are explicitly rejected in the sandbox, and moving to production means swapping one URL. Missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server, CLI or agent skills can target the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.
